description: Scrape StockTwits messages, aggregate sentiment and its history, trending tickers, quotes, fundamentals, price bars, profiles, search, and reply threads.

chartZoom.description: Intraday windows use 5-minute (1D) or 30-minute (1W) bars; other windows use daily/weekly bars.
chartZoom.title: Price history window (mode=priceHistory)

contentFilter.description: Keep only messages with this attachment. Videos are rare; All keeps every message.
contentFilter.title: Content filter (message modes)

feedType.description: Trending = market-wide trending posts; Suggested = posts from StockTwits' curated suggested traders; All = public market-wide firehose (deep, chronological).
feedType.title: Market feed (mode=marketMessages)

includeRelatedSymbols.description: Add StockTwits' related-industry tickers to each symbol record.
includeRelatedSymbols.title: Include related tickers (mode=symbolOverview)

includeUserProfile.description: Add one profile record per username before that trader's posts.
includeUserProfile.title: Include trader profile (mode=userMessages)

maxItems.description: Per ticker/username/query/thread for target modes; total for trending and market feeds; max points or bars for history modes.
maxItems.title: Max records

messageIds.description: Message IDs or StockTwits message URLs whose parent + reply thread should be fetched.
messageIds.title: Message IDs (mode=conversation)

newerThanMessageId.description: Only keep messages with an ID greater than this. Useful for incremental scheduled runs.
newerThanMessageId.title: Newer than message ID (message modes)

olderThanMessageId.description: Start from messages at or below this ID and page further back.
olderThanMessageId.title: Older than message ID (message modes)

onlyPriceTargets.description: Keep only messages where the author attached a StockTwits price prediction (price target).
onlyPriceTargets.title: Only price predictions (message modes)

searchQueries.description: Company names, tickers, or trader names to search for, e.g. tesla, apple, TraderLion.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search)

searchType.description: What to return from each query.
searchType.title: Search type (mode=search)

sentimentFilter.description: Keep posts by the author's self-tagged sentiment. Most posts are untagged; Any keeps all.
sentimentFilter.title: Sentiment filter (message modes)

sentimentRange.description: Now = current sentiment across 15m, 24h, now, 1D–ALL. Other values return the daily/intraday history for that window.
sentimentRange.title: Sentiment range (mode=symbolSentiment)

streamFilter.description: All = newest first, Top = StockTwits ranking, Trending = curated high-engagement posts for the ticker (up to 100).
streamFilter.title: Message sort (mode=symbolMessages)

symbols.description: Tickers to fetch, e.g. AAPL, TSLA, BTC.X, BRK.B, SHOP.TSX. Accepts $cashtags and StockTwits symbol URLs. Use .X for crypto.
symbols.title: Tickers (mode=symbolMessages / symbolSentiment / symbolOverview / priceHistory)

trendingAssetClass.description: Which trending instruments to keep. All includes stocks, ETFs, crypto, ADRs, commodities, and other classes.
trendingAssetClass.title: Asset class (mode=trendingSymbols)

usernames.description: StockTwits usernames without @, or profile URLs, e.g. KirRoyalTrader, https://stocktwits.com/Fibonaccino.
usernames.title: Usernames (mode=userMessages)

title: StockTwits Scraper Input
